## Introduction

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(readr)
library(tidyverse)

# Function to extract ICD-10-PCS codes
extract_icd10pcs <- function(text) {
  # ICD-10-PCS: 7 chars, A-Z (except I,O) and 0-9
  pattern <- "\\b[0-9A-HJ-NP-Z]{7}\\b"
  
  codes <- str_extract_all(text, pattern)[[1]]
  unique(codes)
}

# read in full list of 2026 ICD 10 codes from https://www.cms.gov/files/zip/2026-icd-10-pcs-codes-file.zip (7 character code and description)
icd10codes_2026 <- read_fwf(
  file = "data/2026-icd-10-pcs-codes-file/icd10pcs_codes_2026.txt",
  fwf_cols(
    code = c(1, 7),
    description = c(9, NA)  # skip 1 space between code and description
  ),
  col_types = cols(.default = "c")
)

icd10codes_2018 <- read_fwf(
  file = "data/2018-icd-10-pcs-codes-file/icd10pcs_codes_2018.txt",
  fwf_cols(
    code = c(1, 7),
    description = c(9, NA)  # skip 1 space between code and description
  ),
  col_types = cols(.default = "c")
)

icd10codes <- bind_rows(
  icd10codes_2026 %>% mutate(source = "2026"),
  icd10codes_2018 %>% mutate(source = "2018")
) %>%
  arrange(code, desc(source)) %>%  # keep 2026 first if both exist
  distinct(code, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  select(-source)

head(icd10codes)
```

# ICD-10-PCS

## ICD-10-PCS codes from the HCUP CCSR categories
- included amongst the categories are 
appendectomy
cholecystectomy
gastric bypass - "Gastro-jejunal bypass (including bariatric)"
colon resection - "colectomy"
anterior or posterior spinal arthrodesis - "Spine fusion"
craniotomy for brain tumor - ?"CNS excision procedures"
total knee replacement - ?"Knee arthroplasty"
total hip replacement - ?"Hip arthroplasty"
open repair of femoral neck or shaft fracture - ?"Femur fixation"
total thyroidectomy 
lung resection - "Lung, pleura, or diaphragm resection (open and thoracoscopic)"

```{r}
# Function to expand wildcard codes
expand_wildcards <- function(wildcard_string, master_codes) {
  wildcard_vector <- unlist(strsplit(wildcard_string, split = "[, \n]+"))
  wildcard_vector <- trimws(wildcard_vector)
  
  expanded <- map(wildcard_vector, function(pat) {
    regex_pat <- paste0("^", str_replace_all(pat, "x", ""))
    master_codes$code[str_detect(master_codes$code, regex_pat)]
  }) %>% unlist()
  
  unique(expanded)
}
```

line-by-line file

```{r}
# make into tibble for joining
ICD10_List <- tibble(ICD10_List)

# join with icd10codes on the code
noncardiacSGYlookupICD10 <- ICD10_List %>%
  left_join(icd10codes, by = c("code")) %>%
  rename(`Code` = code,
         `Full Description` = description) %>%
  mutate(
    Class = word(Type, 3, sep = "_"), 
    Approach = str_extract(`Full Description`,
                           "(Open Approach|Percutaneous Endoscopic Approach|Percutaneous Approach|Natural or Artificial Opening Endoscopic|External Approach|Natural or Artificial Opening With Percutaneous Endoscopic Assistance|Via Natural or Artificial Opening$)")
  ) %>% 
  arrange(Class, Code) %>% 
  select(-Type)
write.csv(noncardiacSGYlookupICD10, "output/ICD_noncardiacSGY_lookup.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```


# CPT codes

## CPT codes from the HCUP CCSR categories
- included amongst the categories are 

appendectomy
cholecystectomy - "Cholecystectomy and common duct exploration"
gastric bypass - "Gastric bypass and volume reduction"
anterior or posterior spinal arthrodesis - "spinal fusion"
total knee replacement - "Arthroplasty knee"
total hip replacement - "Hip replacement, total and partial"
open repair of femoral neck or shaft fracture - "Treatment, fracture or dislocation of hip and femur"
total thyroidectomy - "Thyroidectomy, partial or complete"
lung resection - "Lobectomy or pneumonectomy"

```{r}
names(CPT_List) <- c("code", "Type")

CPT_List$code <- gsub("^'?(\\w+)-\\1'?$", "'\\1'", CPT_List$code)

CPT_List <- CPT_List %>%
  mutate(code = str_remove_all(code, "'")) %>%   # remove single quotes
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    code = if (str_detect(code, "-")) {
      # Split range, convert to numeric, and expand
      range <- str_split(code, "-", simplify = TRUE)
      start <- as.numeric(range[1])
      end <- as.numeric(range[2])
      list(as.character(seq(start, end)))
    } else {
      list(code)
    }
  ) %>%
  unnest(code) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  distinct(code, .keep_all = TRUE)
```

```{r}
# List the 4 CSV files
CPTfiles <- c("data/CPTdictionary/cptmedical1.csv", "data/CPTdictionary/cptmedical2.csv", "data/CPTdictionary/cptmedical3.csv", "data/CPTdictionary/cptmedical4.csv")

# Read and stack them into one tibble
CPTcodes <- CPTfiles %>%
  map_dfr(~ read_csv(.x, col_types = cols(
    `PROC CODE` = col_character(),
    `PROCEDURE DESCRIPTION` = col_character()
  ))) %>%
  distinct(`PROC CODE`, .keep_all = TRUE) %>% 
  select(`PROC CODE`, `PROCEDURE DESCRIPTION`)
names(CPTcodes) <- c("code", "description")
```

line-by-line file

```{r}
# make into tibble for joining
CPT_List <- tibble(CPT_List)

# join with CPTcodes on the code
noncardiacSGYlookupCPT <- CPT_List %>%
  left_join(CPTcodes, by = c("code")) %>%
  rename(`Code` = code,
         `Full Description` = description) %>%
  mutate(
    Class = word(Type, 3, sep = "_")
  ) %>% 
  arrange(Class, Code) %>% 
  select(-Type)
write.csv(noncardiacSGYlookupCPT, "output/CPT_noncardiacSGY_lookup.csv", row.names = FALSE)

```
